marking_points.criterion: Prints digit indices, not zero counts.
Prints All present only when no absent digits.

partial_credit_notes: Award independent criteria up to the stated total; accept equivalent technically correct wording/solutions.

verification.technical: Output checked for counts with only8 absent and all present.
verification.test_code:
def show_absent(counts):
    found = False
    for value in range(10):
        if counts[value] == 0:
            print(value)
            found = True
    if not found:
        print("All present")
import io,contextlib
b=io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(b):show_absent([1]*8+[0,1])
assert b.getvalue()=="8\n"
b=io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(b):show_absent([1]*10)
assert b.getvalue()=="All present\n"
